items.title: He’s been badmouthing Treasury bonds since 2020, but now ‘the big fat cushion’ of 5.25% yields is turning this strategist bullish
items.description: Investors have become accustomed to returns distorted by artificially low interest rates.  5% on bonds and 6% on stocks are more realistic and Bianco finds value in U.S. Treasury notes now.

items.title: One group of funds is holding up the stock market. Barclays says oil prices have to fall to drive a year-end rally.
items.description: Strategists at the bank said a rally at the end of the year would likely depend on oil prices lowering or stabilizing even as the historically best-performing quarter approaches.

items.title: There’s a new Wall Street TACO index — and this one is saying it’s time for Trump to strike a deal
items.description: JPMorgan has devised a TACO barometer, referring to the expression Trump Always Chickens Out ,as a way to predict the behavior of the mercurial world leader.

items.title: I’m 71 and still working. I earn $108,000 a year. Am I doing the right thing?
items.description: “I have $152,000 in my IRA and Roth accounts.”

items.title: Netflix stars Nick and Vanessa Lachey list $8.1 million L.A. home they bought from Naomi Osaka
items.description: TV stars Nick and Vanessa Lachey are bidding farewell to their longtime “dream home,” listing the Tarzana property for $8.1 million as they prepare to leave California altogether.

items.title: Tuesday’s market moves was one of the more disturbing days of late, says Goldman Sachs pro
items.description: Beneath the languished moves in the main stock-market indexes, there were some disturbing features.

items.title: ‘I have $400,000 in equity’: I’m 80. Should I sell my house because of dangerous stairs — or spend thousands renovating?
items.description: “Generally, the advice I’ve read says not to sell because I have a low-interest-rate mortgage.”

items.title: ‘I’m never selling’: I’m 47 and buy bitcoin with every dollar I earn. Am I crazy?
items.description: “When my paycheck lands, it takes a detour through bitcoin.”

items.title: I’m 77, pay rent and live off Social Security, but I help homeless people. Why are so many people going hungry?
items.description: “I am a retired senior citizen living check-to-check.”

items.title: ‘We lived within our means’: I earned $30,000 as a pastor and still retired comfortably. Why don’t you tell people that?
items.description: “As a country, we have grown dangerously comfortable.”
